name: Average Snake 9
author: krlozCJ
description: Outlined black login form that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes translateX(-50%). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 0px #0e0e0e, 0px 0px 0px rgb(95 94 94 / 25%), inset 3px 3px 4px #0e0e0e, inset -3px -3px 4px #5f5e5e, transform becomes translate(-150%, -50%).
